title: Selected credentials echoed into captures bypass the default seal guard
claim: For an explicitly selected full capture run without --canaries, a selected credential echoed in Agent/native output is copied byte-for-byte into an Exportable artifact and can be successfully sealed. Temporary credential-file cleanup does not prevent that exposure.

evidence.detail: No canary file produces an empty list.
Resolved selected credential flows to projection, not automatic privacy scan list.
Complete raw Agent stdout/stderr captured without redaction.
Generic stage assigns Sensitivity::Exportable to these bytes.
Only request.canaries determine privacy seal refusal.

reproduction: Inline Python imported test_native_integrations.py with bytecode disabled; set synthetic STDOUT and agent_env TEST_CREDENTIAL to the same dummy string, then setup/run each Harbor/Pier Opi/pi integration with existing FakeEnvironment

All four combinations retained the exact dummy key in stdout.log and confirmed temporary stage cleanup. No shell, container, provider, network or real secret involved. This proves capture preservation; the subsequent successful seal/export exposure is the static source-to-sink invariant.

Static continuation: raw captures at runner/experiment.rs:2271-2287 -> stage Exportable at 3481-3498 -> empty-list scan at 2530-2548 -> bundle.seal at 2551. Use only a dummy selected key and a full-capture tool/native stream that echoes it; omit --canaries.

refutation.searched: Selected-credential resolver/projection, both integrations, generic bundle staging, CLI/report canary paths, current native privacy/credential tests.
refutation.strongest_counterevidence: Explicit --canaries rejects before seal and stops dispatch (native_driver.rs:1821-1883); actual config/handoff files are removed (1407-1470); raw failed diagnostics intentionally remain private.
refutation.why_not_refuted: Neither cleanup nor opt-in canary tests automatically enrolls the selected key; a normal full capture without --canaries still promotes echoed key bytes to sealed export. The finding does not object to unsealed private diagnostic retention.

title: Replacement reruns other groups under their old trial identities
claim: Replacing one group in a multi-group experiment dispatches the complete retained trial list, while only target-group trial IDs are refreshed. Every unrelated group is therefore executed and sealed again with its old trial ID, violating the fresh-identity rule for new real execution. Same-scope replacement is allowed; every rerun must receive a fresh trial identity.

evidence.detail: Refreshes IDs only where trial.group equals target group.
All experiment trials are iterated and executed into the new root.
Current test expects unrelated new_id = old_id and later reads the new sealed bundle for that ID.
TrialIdentity is the unqualified String; IntentRecord stores it separately from experiment contract.

reproduction: cargo test -p opi-eval --test assembled_run replacement_fresh_resolved_pairs_preserve_original_scope -- --exact (parent handles execution).

Read the selected=false branch: it creates unrelated-group, invokes replacement in fresh roots, preserves unchanged old IDs at 149-166 and reads newly sealed output for them at 168-190. Static run loop establishes each is a new execution.

refutation.searched: replace_group, subsequent dispatch loop, TrialIdentity/IntentRecord, recovery and current replacement integration test.
refutation.strongest_counterevidence: A fresh experiment ID and target paired-group suffix are created; original root bytes remain unchanged. Current test deliberately expects unrelated IDs unchanged.
refutation.why_not_refuted: Fresh experiment identity and immutable prior bytes do not give each new execution a fresh TrialIdentity. Test expectations document current behavior but cannot override normative CTRL-006.

title: Native result admission does not bind the observed task package reference
claim: A completed native result can change config.task.path to another absolute package with the same lifecycle (even a different declared task name or grader bytes), while retaining the selected result.task_name, and still pass the native result importer and post-settlement configuration comparison. The path is not compared with the frozen dispatched package and its contents are not admitted against that package. The runner then seals the contradictory config as selected-trial evidence. This claim concerns rejection of substituted observed evidence, not a claim that the pinned upstream runner normally dispatches the wrong task.

evidence.detail: Reads any absolute observed config.task.path and parses it; result is only mode/declarations/base/image (1111-1116), omitting task name, path and package hash.
Equality checks only TaskLifecycleSelection fields against selected facts.
Only effective environment import/caps/multipliers compared; expected tasks[0].path is unused.
Admitted native config/result are copied into sealed evidence; classification/sealing has no later task path/package check.

reproduction: Static invariant: NativeSelection contains no admitted task path/package digest; parse_recorded_lifecycle consumes arbitrary absolute observed task path but projects away task name and file identity; native_stage_config_matches never compares task path.

Executed the included audit_probe appended only to the disposable exported process.rs: cargo test --offline -p opi-eval --lib audit_native_result_accepts_substituted_task_reference. PASS: 1 executed, importer accepted the substituted task reference and native_stage_config_matches returned true. Original source bytes were restored and the complete archive byte comparison passed.

refutation.searched: All three family admission/settle methods, BenchmarkExecution::run, run_native_trial classification/sealing, current native_driver and process.rs substitution tests.
refutation.strongest_counter_evidence: Before spawn the selected task bytes are admitted (terminal_bench_21.rs:742-762; terminal_bench_30.rs:942-967; deepswe.rs:973-1022), native_job_config:1589-1629 sends the exact canonical task path, and cleanup ownership is bounded to expected task roots. Tests reject pre-dispatch package drift and changed result task label.
refutation.why_not_refuted: Those facts prove intended dispatch and cleanup authority, not equality of the observed result package reference with the dispatched package. The importer explicitly accepts observed task identity from another path. No registered deferral permits contradictory native task evidence.

title: Acceptance provenance trusts an unbound operator cache and optional inventories
claim: The offline acceptance verifier admits arbitrary upstream repository/commit pairs when the same pairs are added to the supplied identity-cache JSON. It does not bind those records to admitted external inventories. Empty material and preserved-artifact lists also pass their checks. Thus acceptance can affirm provenance without proving the required pinned runner/source/material identities.
criterion_source: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-05-phase19-local-native-agent-evaluation-design.md#8. Verification and local acceptance handoff; projected tasks 19.10–19.11

evidence.detail: check_material loops over an optional list without required-family cardinality; check_preserved at 282 similarly accepts an empty list.
check_upstream_identities compares manifest.sources only to the supplied upstream-identity-cache.json. It verifies no cache identity, admitted lock entry or repository contents.
Downstream Companion calls are only verify/report, whose inputs are bundle seals and report content, not manifest.sources or the upstream cache.

reproduction: Using existing test_verify_local_acceptance.EvidenceRoot, set each source URL to https://example.invalid/unadmitted/<name> and commit to forty zeroes, add those pairs to upstream-identity-cache.json, and empty manifest.material and manifest.preserved. check_upstream_identities/check_material/check_preserved all return successfully.

Run current public verification CLI with this existing recording Companion stub: exit 0, accepted=true, six trials. Audit script ../checks/probe_acceptance.py reproduced this. The stub isolates verifier validation; it is not real native-trial evidence.

refutation.searched: Complete Acceptance.run, check_controls/check_agent_observations/check_scoped_view/check_companion, the actual Rust verify/report consumers and all 45 acceptance verifier tests.
refutation.strongest_counterevidence: Tests reject a source pair absent from the supplied cache. Controls and runtime preflight are byte-bound to bundle entries, and real Companion verification rejects malformed or mutated bundles.
refutation.why_not_refuted: Coordinated source/cache substitution is outside those checks. Companion byte verification never consumes the upstream cache and cannot establish its link to admitted material; selected runtime hashes do not validate Harbor/Pier source claims.

title: Required reasoning can run with unsupported effective control
claim: A native experiment with reasoning="high" and required=["reasoning"] is admitted before effects; Pi is launched with --thinking off, and reasoning is only declared unsupported during post-execution pairing. Required unsupported controls therefore do not fail before native execution.

evidence.detail: Any supplied reasoning value satisfies required list.
Native admission enumerates only temperature and top_p.
Additional admission recognizes only max_output_tokens.
Native pi launch explicitly disables thinking; Pier has same command at 855.
Unsupported reasoning is added after job execution and sealing.

reproduction: Static invariant: configure native Pi with reasoning="high", required=["reasoning"], otherwise valid pinned material. Resolve sees a Value; admit_native_controls has no reasoning check; output_control::admit checks only max_output_tokens; native command still includes --thinking off.
python crates/opi-eval/scripts/test_native_integrations.py -q: executed test_package_and_single_binary_launches_retain_evidence asserts --thinking off at line 715.

refutation.searched: ResolvedExperiment required validation, both public native plan/run admission paths, output-control evidence, both integration commands, post-execution comparability and current required-control tests.
refutation.strongest_counterevidence: Unsupported sampling and unproven required output limits reject before dispatch. Existing required reasoning test at experiment_contract.rs:771-778 rejects an omitted value; post-run pairing refuses reasoning comparability.
refutation.why_not_refuted: The required reasoning test never supplies high; post-run non-comparability occurs after the forbidden effects and does not satisfy pre-execution rejection.
